title: LINZ Christchurch earthquake-response aerial orthophotography, 24 February 2011
sourceName: Wikimedia Commons / LINZ post-earthquake aerial survey
credit: New Zealand Aerial Mapping for the Christchurch Response Centre, from LINZ post-earthquake aerial photography. CC BY 3.0 New Zealand.
altText: High-resolution aerial orthophoto of Cashmere High School and nearby Christchurch landscape captured after the February 2011 earthquake.
caption: New Zealand Aerial Mapping orthophotography of the Cashmere High School area, captured 24 February 2011 for the Christchurch Response Centre, with earthquake-related liquefaction visible on the school playing fields.
context: Genuine disaster-response orthophotography captured two days after the 22 February 2011 Christchurch earthquake. It is an operational imagery product, not a screenshot from the Common Operating Picture.
